steps.summary: Sign-in and ticket creation had already completed via the replayed procedure (its step-5 wait_for merely timed out before the list refreshed). On http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets the refreshed list shows the new ticket at the top: exact title "fwrd3-n3 RD Bench Ticket", assigned reference RD-1015 (detail link #/tickets/t15), customer Bench Customer, status Draft, 0 parts, created 2026-08-26. Screenshot saved as ticket-created-list.png.

On ticket RD-1015 ("fwrd3-n3 RD Bench Ticket"), opened the Add part dialog and added part "fwrd3-n3 RD Part A" with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. The dialog closed and the parts table on the ticket detail page refreshed showing the new row. The app computed a price of $125.00 ($100.00 + 25% markup, qty 1). All values verified from the live page: name = fwrd3-n3 RD Part A, cost = $100.00, markup = 25%, price = $125.00.

Opened the Add part dialog on ticket RD-1015, filled Part Name = "fwrd3-n3 RD Part B", Cost = 200, Markup = 25, and submitted. The parts table refreshed showing both parts. Part A ("fwrd3-n3 RD Part A"): cost $100.00, markup 25%, price $125.00. Part B ("fwrd3-n3 RD Part B"): cost $200.00, markup 25%, price $250.00. The ticket parts total is $375.00. All values confirmed from the live page.

On ticket RD-1015, clicked Edit on Part A ("fwrd3-n3 RD Part A"), changed its cost from $100.00 to $150.00, and saved. The parts table refreshed. Part A now shows: cost $150.00, markup 25% (unchanged), price $187.50 ($150 + 25%). Part B ("fwrd3-n3 RD Part B") untouched: cost $200.00, markup 25%, price $250.00. Ticket parts total: $437.50 ($187.50 + $250.00). All values confirmed from the live page.

(a) On clicking Mark Ready, the app showed an alert: "Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd3-n3 RD Part B" has no supplier". (b) The skill had already set a supplier (Bench Supplier) for Part A, but Part B still showed No supplier. I opened Part B's Edit dialog, filled Supplier = Bench Supplier, and saved. Then clicked Mark Ready — no further errors. (c) The ticket's status is now "Ready" as shown on the page (the Mark Draft and Mark Closed buttons are present, confirming the transition).

values.initial_error: Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd3-n3 RD Part B" has no supplier
values.satisfied_precondition: Set supplier to Bench Supplier for both Part A (already done by skill) and Part B (done manually by opening Part B's Edit dialog)

steps.summary: (a) Both parts were deleted with delete-confirmation dialogs accepted for each. The parts table now shows "No parts on this ticket yet." (count = 0). (b) Archive was triggered via the list page's Archive button; the skill's dialog_expect accepted the dialog (the dialog had no visible text content, as confirmed from the page — no toast/notification text remained). (c) On the active ticket list (Show archived unchecked), RD-1015 no longer appears; with the checkbox checked, it is visible in the archived state with status "Ready" and an "Archived" badge. On the detail page, the "Unarchive ticket" button is present in place of "Archive ticket".
